# ADR 0030 — Placeholder assets are generated by scripts in tools/

*Status: accepted · 2026-08-23 · made while bootstrapping the repo*

## Decision

Gray-box art is produced by a generator (`tools/gen_probe_obj.py`,
`tools/gen_textures.py`) and committed alongside the generator. `make assets`
regenerates and re-imports.

## Why

An asset review becomes a diff review, and nothing needs a DCC tool to reproduce.
It also means placeholder geometry can be adjusted from the same place as
everything else — the command line.

Real art replaces these files in place. No code knows the difference, and the
generators are deleted or left dormant when that happens.

## What this forbids

- Do not build a runtime dependency on an asset being generated.
- Do not hand-edit a generated asset; edit the generator.
